entities.summary: Barbara Renee Turner is an American former professional basketball player currently working as an assistant coach for the South Bay Lakers of the NBA G League. She acquired US / Turkish dual citizenship while playing in Turkey; her name in Turkish is spelled Bahar Öztürk.
